items.title: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams Interview, 1967-05-13
items.q: And I put it to the John, two and a half to John.

ctx.x: 50 cents. And if they don't die, you got paid two bits. But you could be blanched to it a hundred years, they don't get no more than that 150 dollar thing. A hundred and fifty dollars. And you'd be out of a lot of money in those societies. Oh, yeah. Now, that's all they would give you, $150. And your family got to cover the rest. It could be blanched to the Benevolous for 25 or 30 years, but you just might all them get a quarter to 50 cents a month. And I put it to the John, two and a half to John.
